reasoning: On the season so far the Nets are the stronger team; with home court the Nets start about 1 points better, in a game of about 224 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Nets win 52 times in 100; most games like this end between 198 and 246 total points.
